blocks.html: Closed-Won is a sales pipeline status that indicates a deal has been successfully finalized, and the prospect has agreed to purchase the product or service.

Closed-Won represents the successful conversion of a sales opportunity into a paying customer. It is a key milestone in the sales cycle and directly contributes to recognized revenue and business growth.
A deal is marked as Closed-Won when all sales stages are completed, including:
Provides clear visibility into revenue generation
Helps measure sales team performance and conversion rates
Supports accurate forecasting and pipeline management
Identifies successful sales strategies and patterns
Enables better reporting and business insights
Once these steps are completed and the customer commits to the purchase, the opportunity is moved to the Closed-Won stage in the CRM system.

A sales representative successfully closes a deal after multiple meetings and negotiations, and the client signs the contract. The opportunity is then marked as Closed-Won, contributing to the company’s revenue for that period.

Closed-Won is a critical indicator of sales success, marking the completion of the sales process and the start of a customer relationship. Tracking these deals helps businesses evaluate performance and optimize their sales strategies.
